summary: Regression after Hero redesign. Backend 15/15 pytest passed. Frontend E2E covered new Hero (BLINDA O TEU JOGO, hero-cta-btn, /product-hero.png HTTP 200, trust bar, CTA scrolls to #produto), product grid (3 cards), athlete carousel, full purchase flow (add-to-cart -> checkout -> /sucesso with order-number XOKS-1006), and admin tabs. Zero console errors/warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx imports ShieldCheck twice (as ShieldCheck and aliased as ShieldIcon) — works but minor duplication
Hero product image is hidden below md breakpoint (intentional per spec)
Orders API has no DELETE endpoint, so test orders accumulate over iterations (not a blocker but consider TTL/admin cleanup for TEST_ orders)
seed_data_creation: Baseline preserved: 3 products, 6 athletes. One test order XOKS-1006 created during checkout flow (no DELETE endpoint available to remove it).
